label: Town of Fair Haven
header:
# Town of Fair Haven municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 8; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Fair Haven Selectboard members: Keith Hier, Samuel Lucci (Board Clerk), Dennis Reid, Richard Greenough, and Chadd Viger (Chair).

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): the 2026 ballot paired Dennis Reid against an incumbent for the 3-year seat; the board's post-election minutes seat Reid, and the pre-election chair Glen Traverse no longer sits.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): the 2026 moderator contest was write-in only, and the town's published 2026 results could not be obtained; Cecelia Hunt held the office through 2025. The seat is left unfilled. Structure only.
Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): the 2025 ballot likewise carried the moderator office.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): Danielle Laramie was the printed candidate for Town Clerk for a 3-year term in 2025 (ballot prints 'Danielle (Dani Laramie) Roberts'); her term runs to 2028, so the office was not on the 2026 ballot.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Danielle Laramie as Town Clerk of Fair Haven; her form of name governs.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): Sharon Adams was the sole printed candidate for Town Treasurer in 2026 and is minted as the elected holder on the official ballot and her incumbency (sole-candidate pattern).
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Sharon Adams as Town Treasurer of Fair Haven.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): Donald Proctor was the sole printed candidate for First Constable in 2025 on the office's 2-year cycle and is minted as the elected holder (sole-candidate pattern). The two constable posts run on alternating cycles and each appears only on its own year's ballot.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): Sean Galvin was the sole printed candidate for Second Constable in 2026 on the office's 2-year cycle and is minted as the elected holder (sole-candidate pattern).

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): Sharon Adams (3-year term) and John (Jack) Adams (2-year remainder) were the sole printed lister candidates in 2025 and are minted as elected (sole-candidate pattern). The lister John (Jack) Adams is minted as a separate person from the justice of the peace of the same printed name: the town's JP slate itself distinguishes two John Adamses and no source ties the lister to either.
Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): Peter M. Laramie was the sole printed candidate for the 3-year lister seat in 2026 and is minted as elected.
Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): both auditor seats on the 2025 ballot were write-in only.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): the 2026 auditor contest was likewise write-in only, and the town's published 2026 results could not be obtained; no winners are published in the sources read, so all three seats are left unfilled. Structure only.

offices.title: Trustee of Public Funds
offices.org_name: Fair Haven Trustees of Public Funds

sources.note: Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): Maureen Hall was the sole printed candidate for the 3-year Trustee of Public Funds seat in 2026 and is minted as elected.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): Peter M. Laramie (3-year term) and Judith Gevry (2-year remainder) were the sole printed candidates in 2025 and are minted as elected (sole-candidate pattern).

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 4, 2025 (fairhavenvt.gov): Christine Sheldon was the sole printed candidate for a 3-year library trustee seat in 2025 and is minted as elected. The town's elected-officials tables fix the board at five seats.

Town of Fair Haven official sample ballot, Town Meeting March 3, 2026 (fairhavenvt.gov): Cecelia Hunt was the sole printed candidate for the 1-year library seat in 2026 (ballot prints 'Cecelia "Ceil" Hunt') and is minted as elected; two further 2026 seats were write-in only with no published winners, and the remaining seat's holder is not published in current sources, so three seats are left unfilled.

offices.title: Justice of the Peace
offices.org_name: Fair Haven Justices of the Peace

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Fair Haven justices of the peace: Cynthia Adams, John Adams, John (Jack) Adams, Melissa (Katie) Adams-Sliva, Lorraine Brown, Jason Scott Coupal, and Judith Gevry. The slate itself distinguishes John Adams from John (Jack) Adams; both are minted as listed.

jp_election.name: Town of Fair Haven Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists seven Fair Haven justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Cynthia Adams, John Adams, John (Jack) Adams, Melissa (Katie) Adams-Sliva, Lorraine Brown, Jason Scott Coupal, and Judith Gevry. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded.
